results.title: Where Is My Head 2
results.original_title: ឃើញក្បាលខ្ញុំទេ 2
results.overview: When a troubled film production is forced to reshoot, a young writer discovers that the vengeful ghost terrorizing the cast and crew is not the spirit they believe it to be, but a dead actress seeking revenge—and she must uncover the truth before everyone on set becomes her next victim.

results.title: Naa Wife Missing
results.overview: A newly married couple's happy life takes a mysterious turn when the wife suddenly disappears. As the husband seeks help, doubts about her past and hidden secrets begin to surface.

results.title: Free Kick
results.overview: After Ronaldo's free kick shatters a villager's window, he and his friends are forced to wander through the neighborhood in search of a field where they can continue playing.

results.title: Seethe
results.overview: Ever since her father's sudden death by the Ciliwung River, Aci and her mother’s lives changed forever. Convincing herself the Ciliwung Spirit killed him, Aci vows revenge. Yet, her mother repeatedly insists asthma was the cause. Exhausted by Aci's escalating terror, her mother recklessly summons the entity, triggering an inevitable clash.

results.title: First Step
results.overview: As the 100th-day memorial for her younger sibling approaches, 62-year-old Tan Man Moy joins a line-dance community in Petak Enam. As happiness slowly finds its way back into her life, she must confront the guilt of enjoying life again without the person she loved most.

results.title: The Year Without Summer
results.overview: Extreme heat and fires sweep through Tambora, one of Jakarta's most densely populated neighborhoods. Uus returns after years away to live with his brother, Surya, an AC technician. Disturbed by the cramped conditions and constant threat of fires, Uus is determined to move to Japan for a better life, urging Surya to join him.

results.title: On a Bright Blessed Day
results.overview: Gita, an island woman traumatized by the sea, urges her fiancé Dama—a fisherman—to become a tour guide. Caught between the land and the sea, the two must choose one.

results.title: Como amar a mixtli
results.overview: With Armando Montaño, a lawyer, as our guide and friend, we explored various municipalities in the state of Puebla, in the hills and mountains; we investigated the loss of species, the displacement of communities, and their sociocultural implications in the Puebla region. For Armando, who has been climbing mountains for more than 20 years, the loss of flora and fauna signifies a spiritual void, a weakening of humanity. We observed how these communities, steeped in pre-Hispanic legacies, find refuge and a home in the land and how they watch their homes crumble with increasing frequency.

results.title: 5000 Credits
results.overview: Gerhard is 73 and trying to find a young girlfriend from Eastern Europe online. When doubts arise about the authenticity of the dating platform he uses, he turns to his tenant Mascha, 23, for help. As they search for the truth, a more difficult question emerges: is Gerhard ready to let go of the illusion of online love?

results.title: Welcome To Paris
results.overview: American foot model Evie shows up for her first gig in Paris, only to be fired when the agency discovers her foot doesn’t really look “wholesome.”

results.title: Making The Line
results.overview: MAKING THE LINE is a character-driven feature documentary that delves into the world of competitive Hula — where athleticism and artistry are inseparable from a living Hawaiian cultural tradition. At its heart are Kumu Keano and Kumu Lono, two master Hula teachers and life partners who lead a diverse group of dancers striving for excellence in the art and discipline of Hula.  Guided by two modern-day queer Kanaka whose lives infuse the story with emotional truth and cultural nuance, MAKING THE LINE unfolds over three years, exploring tradition, resilience, and identity in a rapidly changing Hawaiʻi. As the demands of excellence intensify, so do the complexities of life both on and off the line. Their story becomes a portrait of devotion, transformation, and the enduring power of Hula — revealing that it is far more than dance; it is the heartbeat of a people.

results.title: Still Water
results.overview: A girl cannot escape the unease she feels in the swimming pool, until a duck suddenly appears. It seems not to care about anything at all.

results.title: È un mondo difficile
results.overview: Elena and Francesco are bound by a love full of ups and downs, a visceral bond that spans the years, the distances, and diverging life choices. As their paths seem to drift apart, something keeps pulling them back to each other. He finds a new balance with Marta, while she becomes involved with Arthur, who offers her stability and a marriage proposal. But with her wedding just around the corner, the only choice left is the one they’ve never had the courage to make.

results.title: MACE – An Out of Body Experience
results.original_title: MACE – An Out of Body Experience
results.overview: For the second time in his career, MACE returns to Milan’s Forum, bringing together on stage the artists who have given voice to his musical universe: Venerus, Gemitaiz, Joan Thiele, Salmo, and many others.More than a chronicle of a concert, the film is a journey through perception: from intimacy to collective experience, from control to ecstasy. Through the words of the artists and images of the preparations and the show, it follows the creation of a shared experience. Rehearsals, stage, and audience merge into a flow in which the boundary between reality and hallucination becomes increasingly blurred.

results.title: Wet Dreams in a Drawer
results.overview: A reflection on early encounters with pornography.

results.title: Art, Chaos, Riot
results.overview: The documentary follows María Riot, an artist, activist, and sex worker from Argentina, as she develops her photography project “Archivo Puta” through conversations, encounters, and photo shoots. It offers a personal glimpse into María’s life, her creative process, and her journey into photography. At the same time, the film explores the portrayal of sex work and questions the boundaries between objectification, self-determination, and political expression.

results.title: Fite Qlub: The Embrace of Community
results.original_title: Fite Qlub: The Embrace of Community
results.overview: A short documentary about an organization in Amsterdam, run by and for queer BIPOC people and those into kink.

results.title: El Frío Que Guía Luz
results.overview: While waiting for the bus, a single mother is suddenly swept into her painful past as she tells her six-year-old daughter a tale.
